title.ja: 終盤、寄せから詰みまでの考え方

path: 上達のためのテクニック

intro.ja:
玉を直接攻めにくければ、玉の近くの金を狙うのが寄せの出発点です。駒の数を足す直接の攻めは分かりやすいですが、一か所に攻め駒が集まり重くなることがあります。相手が取らずに金を逃げたり、歩を動かして逃げ道を作る応手も読みます。

玉を動かして金を浮き駒にする間接の攻めは、攻め駒を動きやすくします。盤上の攻め駒を急いで交換せず、働きを残すことも大切です。一方で龍を切って二つの詰み筋を同時に作る必至が最速の場合もあります。駒得より寄せの速度と自玉の安全を評価します。
intro.en:
When direct king attack is difficult, target a nearby defensive gold. Adding attackers is straightforward but can crowd your pieces and slow the attack. The opponent need not capture: a gold retreat or pawn move opening an escape may undermine your plan. Compare those defenses before deciding that numerical pressure alone produces a decisive attack.

Indirect attacks can move the king away from its gold and keep your attackers mobile. Avoid exchanging effective attacking pieces prematurely. In other positions, sacrificing a dragon creates two mating threats that cannot both be stopped and is the fastest finish. Evaluate king safety and the speed of the resulting attack rather than maximizing material in every variation.

question.ja: 直接の攻めが重くなる理由は？
question.en: Why can a direct attack become heavy?

answer.ja: 攻め駒が一か所に集まり、逃げた玉を追いにくくなるためです。
answer.en: Crowded attackers become less mobile and may struggle to pursue an escaping king.

courses.title: 終盤、寄せから詰みまでの考え方: 図1-1 舟囲いを寄せてみよう → 図2-2 次の銀取りが厳しく攻めが成功
courses.titleEn: From castle attack to mate: Figure 1-1: Let's attack a Boat castle → Figure 2-2: The next threat to the silver is severe and the attack succeeds
courses.goalFormation:
図1-1 舟囲いを寄せてみよう
図1-1は舟囲いの金が1枚はがれた状態です。すでに先手の攻めが決まりそうな局面ですが、ここからの寄せを考えましょう。相手玉がまだ囲いに入っているので、いきなり寄せるのは難しそうです。終盤は基本的に玉を直接攻めるのが最善ですが、まだ攻められない、または攻め手がわからないときは、玉の近くの金を攻めるのが定跡です。このテーマ図では4一の金を攻めるのがよい手になります。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

child.comment:

原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-2: The next threat to the silver is severe and the attack succeeds
If White simply takes with △同金 after ▲5二金, then ▲同と makes the next threat to the silver severe, and Black's attack succeeds. However, White has other replies.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.ja: ▲5二金に△同金としてくれれば成功

原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-1: Stick to the opponent's gold
First look at dropping ▲5二金. It targets the enemy gold directly; can it finish the attack? Adding pieces to the attack is natural, and ▲5二金 threatens both to capture the gold and to capture the silver.

root.commentEn:
Figure 1-1: Let's attack a Boat castle
Diagram 1-1 is a Funakakoi (Boat castle) with one gold stripped away. Black's attack already looks decisive, so consider how to finish. Since the enemy king is still inside its castle, finishing immediately looks hard. In the endgame it is generally best to attack the king directly, but when you cannot yet do so or don't see how, the standard approach is to attack a gold near the king. In this diagram, attacking the gold on 4一 is the good move.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

courses.titleEn: From castle attack to mate: Reference diagram a: After ▲4二金, △同金
courses.goalFormation:
参考図a ▲4二金、△同金としたところ
図2-3から▲4二金、△同金と進むと、参考図aのように意外と攻め手に困ります。この局面でも先手の攻めは好調ですが、図2-4には及びません。攻め駒はすぐに交換せず、盤上にぎりぎりまで残しておくのがコツです。取れる駒をすぐ取ればよいわけではありません。また、直接持ち駒を打って金を狙う攻めは分かりやすく強力ですが、攻め駒が一か所に固まるのが欠点です。攻め駒が渋滞する攻めは「重い攻め」と呼ばれ、確実ですが遅くなりやすいです。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.comment:
参考図a ▲4二金、△同金としたところ
図2-3から▲4二金、△同金と進むと、参考図aのように意外と攻め手に困ります。この局面でも先手の攻めは好調ですが、図2-4には及びません。攻め駒はすぐに交換せず、盤上にぎりぎりまで残しておくのがコツです。取れる駒をすぐ取ればよいわけではありません。また、直接持ち駒を打って金を狙う攻めは分かりやすく強力ですが、攻め駒が一か所に固まるのが欠点です。攻め駒が渋滞する攻めは「重い攻め」と呼ばれ、確実ですが遅くなりやすいです。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
root.commentEn:
Reference diagram a: After ▲4二金, △同金
From Diagram 2-3, if ▲4二金 △同金 follows as in Reference Diagram a, you unexpectedly run short of attacking moves. Black is still doing well there, but not as well as in Diagram 2-4. The knack is not to trade attacking pieces immediately but to keep them on the board as long as possible; capturing every capturable piece right away is not best. Attacking by dropping pieces directly at the gold is clear and strong, but the attackers bunch up in one place. Such a congested attack is called a heavy attack: reliable, but often slow.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

child.commentEn:
Figure 3-2: Straight into a mating shape
If White captures ▲2二香 with △同玉, the gold on 4一 becomes a loose piece. Capturing it with ▲4一飛成 gives a near-finished position. By acting on the king to leave the gold loose, this is also a well-known tesuji for breaking the Funakakoi (Boat castle). But if White answers correctly, he can hold out a little longer.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

courses.goalFormation:
図3-4 相手玉を追い詰めた
と金で玉をじわじわ追い詰めました。次に▲4三ととして銀を狙えば、詰みも間近です。先ほどの直接攻める手と違い、今回は反対側に香車を打って間接的に攻めました。このような攻めは攻め駒が渋滞せず動きやすく、「軽い攻め」になりやすいです。寄せを早くするには攻め駒をべたべた貼らず、さまざまな方向から攻めることが大切です。ただし今回のテーマ図には、もっと早い寄せがありました。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 3-4: The opposing king is cornered
The tokin squeezed the king steadily. Next ▲4三と targeting the silver brings the mate close. Unlike the earlier direct attack, this time the lance was dropped on the opposite side to attack indirectly. Such an attack avoids congestion, lets pieces move freely and tends to be a light attack. To finish faster, attack from various directions instead of piling pieces together. However, this theme diagram had an even faster finish.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

root.comment:
図1-1 舟囲いを寄せてみよう
図1-1は舟囲いの金が1枚はがれた状態です。すでに先手の攻めが決まりそうな局面ですが、ここからの寄せを考えましょう。相手玉がまだ囲いに入っているので、いきなり寄せるのは難しそうです。終盤は基本的に玉を直接攻めるのが最善ですが、まだ攻められない、または攻め手がわからないときは、玉の近くの金を攻めるのが定跡です。このテーマ図では4一の金を攻めるのがよい手になります。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
root.commentEn:
Figure 1-1: Let's attack a Boat castle
Diagram 1-1 is a Funakakoi (Boat castle) with one gold stripped away. Black's attack already looks decisive, so consider how to finish. Since the enemy king is still inside its castle, finishing immediately looks hard. In the endgame it is generally best to attack the king directly, but when you cannot yet do so or don't see how, the standard approach is to attack a gold near the king. In this diagram, attacking the gold on 4一 is the good move.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

After ▲4一飛成 △同玉, ▲2二金 creates a forced mate threat (hisshi). White cannot defend at the same time against the mating line with a ▲3二金 drop and the one with a ▲5二金 drop.

原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Reference diagram c: Mating line with ▲5二金
A finish that sacrifices the dragon may be hard for beginners to kyu-level players to think of. But the brinkmate shape in Diagram 4-2 is a basic form that always appears in shogi books. By learning basic shapes repeatedly, brilliant finishes gradually become visible. Even an advanced-looking finish is a combination of basic patterns.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.
